protocol.humanProxy: fixed late-game core policy, baseline bot brain; early shop access for expensive carries
primaryMetrics: AI-only helpers LP saved for AI leakers
notes: Human proxy uses legal purchases, upgrades and available faction strategies; it is not a real player or proof of maximum boss DPS.
The hidden boss requires the normal game eligibility threshold; no forced hidden rounds or bonus layers.
Normal field defense is never sacrificed to improve the relay trial score.
protocol.savedLpDefinition: Only recipients still alive after settlement; AI-only support requires all helpers to be actual AI seats. Elimination HP truncation is not credited as rescue.

definitions.teamWins: Team victory, including victories after the human has been eliminated.
definitions.humanAliveWins: Team victory with the fixed human proxy still alive.
definitions.aiOnlySavedLp: Sum over normal rounds: min(10, own counted leaks) minus actual LP loss; only AI recipients alive after settlement and all helpers are true AI.
definitions.humanSavedLp: Same survivor-only LP reduction for the human proxy; helpers can include any eligible player.
definitions.aiPerfectRounds: Observed team rounds with at least one true AI recording a perfect own-field battle; not an independent per-round sample.
definitions.humanDealtBossDamage: Proxy recorded positive boss damage; not inferred merely from team progress.

limitations: Fixed greedy late-game human proxy is not a real human or a globally optimal Boss-DPS policy.
No hidden boss was reached in these samples; second-boss cooperation is not validated.
The relay trial samples at most 12 previewed enemies on the real single-helper route; it is not a forecast of actual leaks or a joint two-helper optimizer.
Same initial seeds do not imply identical later shops after policies consume different random draws.
Small samples and mixed per-seed outcomes do not establish a stable win-rate gain.
Final ABYSS confirmation and broad regression preceded the metadata-only contentInfo.kind correction; this field is not consumed by combat. Final focused tests verify it.
